newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished 1.46 percent down amid profit-taking before settlement but dealers said the index might open mixed on Monday.
"There is more room for profit-taking but it all depends on what Nawaz Sharif has to announce in his speech (on Sunday night)," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan of BMA Capital Management said.
Sharif was due to speak on television to put forward his plans for revamping the economy.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 25.88 points to end at 1,749.69. Losers led gainers 238 to 39. Turnover fell to 48 million shares from Thursday's 90 million.
